photo.credit: NASA / JPL-Caltech · Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter artist's concept (PIA07245). MOI — Mars Orbit Insertion — is the single irreversible burn that captures a spacecraft into Mars orbit; MRO's 27-minute burn in March 2006 was the deepest Mars capture maneuver attempted to that point.
